citations.title: PDAcc: A Prefill-Decode Disaggregated MCM-Based Accelerator for Multi-Task Large Language Model Applications
citations.quote: This work presentsPDAcc, a four-chiplet multi-chip-module (MCM) accelerator optimized for PD-disaggregated LLM inference. PDAcc employs reconfigurable chiplets that can be dynamically assigned to prefill or decode according to workload ratios.

citations.title: PDAcc: A Prefill-Decode Disaggregated MCM-Based Accelerator for Multi-Task Large Language Model Applications
citations.quote: Implemented in 22-nm technology as a four-chiplet MCM

citations.title: PDAcc: A Prefill-Decode Disaggregated MCM-Based Accelerator for Multi-Task Large Language Model Applications
citations.quote: It further introduces three techniques: copy-less float hybrid-LUT multiply (CFHM) to repurpose idle on-chip SRAM for prefill acceleration, hybrid compressed weight gather (HCWG) to utilize prefill-side bandwidth and improve inter-chip weight delivery for decode, and cross-cluster attention dataflow (CCAD) to reduce dependency traffic by shifting part of attention computation across clusters.
